title: Kernel pairs restrict to specified scheme coproduct components
statement: Let S be a scheme, I an arbitrary indexing type, X_i and R_ij S-schemes, and p_ij:R_ij→X_i and t_ij:R_ij→X_j morphisms. Let V, W be specified coproducts in Sch/S of X_i and R_ij, with injections ι_i and κ_ij. Suppose s,t:W→V restrict to p_ij followed by ι_i and t_ij followed by ι_j. For any set-valued presheaf F on Sch/S and any q:h_V→F whose kernel pair is represented by (s,t), each square (h_Rij→h_Xi,h_Rij→h_Xj,q_i,q_j), with projections p_ij,t_ij and q_i=h(ι_i)q, is a pullback of presheaves. No topology, smallness of I, or nonemptiness of the test scheme is assumed.

proof.text: A specified coproduct in Sch/S remains a coproduct of schemes under the forgetful functor. Its injections are open immersions, have disjoint images, and jointly cover. For arbitrary I, prove this without a global small coproduct instance: separate a chosen component using the binary coproduct X_i coproduct V to express its injection as the pullback of a binary injection; use the union of the open images and the coproduct mapping property for coverage; use V coproduct V to distinguish two indices for disjointness.

On a test T, lift compatible maps x:T→X_i,y:T→X_j through the global kernel pair to r:T→W. Any point r(z) lies in a component R_ab. Its s-image is both in X_a and X_i, hence a=i; the t-image gives b=j. Thus r has image inside the open immersion κ_ij. Lift through κ_ij, including when T is empty; the two projections are x and y by monicity of ι_i and ι_j.

For uniqueness, two maps to R_ij with the same p_ij and t_ij have equal composites with κ_ij by the global kernel-pair universal property, hence are equal by monicity of κ_ij. Commutativity is the global kernel-pair equation precomposed with κ_ij. Apply the pointwise pullback criterion for Type-valued presheaves.

theorem scheme_coproduct_kernel_pair_components
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v} (X : I → Over S) (R : I → I → Over S)
    (p : ∀ i j, R i j ⟶ X i)
    (t' : ∀ i j, R i j ⟶ X j)
    (V W : Over S) (ι : ∀ i, X i ⟶ V) (κ : ∀ ij : I × I, R ij.1 ij.2 ⟶ W)
    (hV : IsColimit (Cofan.mk V ι)) (hW : IsColimit (Cofan.mk W κ))
    (s t : W ⟶ V)
    (hs : ∀ i j, κ (i, j) ≫ s = p i j ≫ ι i)
    (ht : ∀ i j, κ (i, j) ≫ t = t' i j ≫ ι j)
    {F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ F)
    (hkernel : IsPullback (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) q q) :
    ∀ i j, IsPullback (yoneda.map (p i j)) (yoneda.map (t' i j))
      (yoneda.map (ι i) ≫ q) (yoneda.map (ι j) ≫ q)
